g.text: 175 retained types have 25 exact universal relations: rank ≤150 for each fixed denominator; these are not 175 independent corrections.

g.text: Initial square tests failed. Rebuilding then simplifies the equations; it adds no independent quadrics in these five cases.

g.text: This is a family search with exact witnesses. It is not a certificate of existence or a solution of the instance.
